findings.message: Added setSelectedProfissional to publish the selected id and load the contract-backed professional record.
Added createProfessionalDraft and updateProfessionalDraft states with setters because both forms edit command inputs.
The create and update command outputs explicitly declare professionals.items upsert; the returned professional is converted to the directory projection and upserted without a reload.
public createProfessionalDraft is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
